answer: Scale each reward by marginal novelty against the identity's cluster. At close every accepted answer is embedded and funding-root clusters formed from the graph. Payout scales with new ground an answer covers beyond the nearest prior answer in its cluster, so the second near-duplicate earns a fraction and the tenth almost nothing. A farm paraphrasing one fable across many keys collects once, not ten times. The deferred share sits in a vault held until the score finalizes; a wharf of aliases spun to dodge it is re-linked on first traced funding. Cost scales with distinct ideas, not keys.
